title: Component: Nushell
requirement: Nushell must be installed and used, not replaced.

evidence.native_typed_pipeline_command: nu --no-config-file --commands "[[component version mode]; [Nushell (version) native_typed_pipeline]] | where component == Nushell | select component version mode | to json --raw"
blueprint_contracts: Nushell alone converts adapter text to typed Nu values.
Native Nushell values flow through a typed Nu pipeline without rtk or rtk_nu.

conclusion: Nushell 0.113.1 is installed and was directly used to execute a native typed table pipeline. No substitute component was used.
